name: Henry Lloyd-Hughes
profileSummary: Henry Lloyd-Hughes is a British actor. His credits include Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire (2005), Unrelated (2007), The Inbetweeners (2008–2010), Miliband of Brothers (2010), Weekender (2011), Anna Karenina (2012), Parade's End (2012), Indian Summers (2015), Les Misérables (2018),  Killing Eve (2019), The English Game (2020), Ragdoll (2021) and The Irregulars (2021).
